info.title: start.spring.io
info.description: The Spring Initializr's catalogue: every starter it offers, grouped, with the Spring Boot versions it supports. Keyless; answers in JSON only to the Accept header the realm's apis.yml sends.

get.description: `dependencies.values[]` are groups `{name, values: [{id, name, description, versionRange?}]}`; `bootVersion.values[]` the Spring Boot versions offered, `bootVersion.default` the recommended one.

get.summary: Which version of each BOM fits which Spring Boot
get.description: `bom-ranges`: per BOM (spring-cloud, spring-ai, …), each of its versions mapped to the Spring Boot range it fits, e.g. `{"2025.1.0": "Spring Boot >=4.0.0 and <4.1.0-M1"}`.
